description: One-shot and unsupervised: open a URL in a throwaway browser and, for each key in schema, return the text that follows that key on the page (as in "Price: $10"), or null. Nothing persists and no one can watch; for pages behind a sign-in, start a supervised session and read them with get_a11y_tree or get_text. API docs: https://roveapi.com/docs.

schema.description: The fields to return. Each key is a label to find in the page text (e.g. {"price": "the product price"}); the values are notes for you and are not used.

url.description: Full URL of the page to read (e.g. "https://example.com/product/123").

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before reading, for content that loads later.

name: extract_schema
title: Extract fields from a URL
